confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Vientiane pricing. No live listings or booking pages were checked, and no web search was used for prices. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most reliable. Hostel and hotel rates vary by room type and season (July is rainy season), so they are less certain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct bar and wine knowledge is weaker. Kip prices move with a volatile currency and high inflation, so nominal values may drift. The FX observation came from web search results that summarized RBA pages rather than a direct page read, so verify it against the RBA daily table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: a lower-cost Southeast Asian capital, priced below Bangkok and above rural Laos, with prices quoted in kip. Cocktail and wine are set using the local price relationship to the beer anchor.
